cards.front: What is a chain of thought?
cards.back: A series of intermediate natural-language reasoning steps that lead to the final output.
Few-shot prompting where each exemplar includes a chain of thought before its answer.
Few-shot prompting with plain input–output exemplars; the model answers directly.
Chain of thought does not help until the model is large enough; small models can even get worse.
PaLM 540B with just eight chain-of-thought exemplars reached state-of-the-art accuracy on GSM8K.
It lets the model spend more computation on multi-step problems and shows how it reached an answer.
